about: Claude's suggested grades for the HLD calibration set (CANVAS-6, AI-5), PROVISIONAL. Suggestions only: the owner accepts or changes each at /admin/hld-calibration, and only the owner's stored grades count for eval-hld-judge. Each carries the fingerprint of the design it was written for (Q-WD-32): one whose design has since changed is shown as outdated, never offered. Drafted 2026-11-24 against calibration.json's 186 designs (spec 1.0, 2.0 and 2.1 families) and the judge's level anchors; otp-login's, payment-processing's and notification-service's re-suggested the same day for their picked providers and payment fees (ADR-0053).
